notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Mini-update 1.4.1 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Vær hilset, store krigere!

We are pleased to announce that the 1.4,1 update for Blood Rage: Digital Edition is now available.
It might seem tiny, but it is fixing an issue that was really hurting the players' experience on Mac.

CHANGE LOG

 Graphical issue fixed (affected only some specific Mac hardware)
 Unity engine updated

We hope these few tweaks will improve yout gaming experience!

 Følg oss inn i strid, brødre og søstre, for ære gis kun den fryktløse!

Join us in battle, brothers and sisters, as glory only belongs to the fearless!

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Update 1.3 patch notes
notes.notes:
Góðan daginn brave and wise warriors!

The day shines bright ahead as we are coming bearing improvements and bug fixes for you all.

Change Log

Improvements & polishes

 Ragnarok effects on provinces are now displayed more clearly with visual cues 
(example: meteorites falling down on the zone)
 The marching arrow to signify your movement to another province is clearer
 Improved card animations and effects for better understanding 
(example: cards are being flipped then revealed, the loser’s card is burnt)
 Clearer battle icons
 The ship zones are showcased in a clearer manner with an anchor icon
 Improved readability on the cost indicator of the cursor
 Updated Compendium with Mystics of Midgard rules
 Clearer visual feedback when clicking a card
 Imrpoved visual feedback when playing a card
 Audio feedback when interacting with cards
 Less feedback for non-interactive elements
 Bigger card zoom and cursor icons to improve readability
 New pointer arrow shows rage cost for call to battle figure movements
 New pointer arrow shows rage cost for mystic withdrawal
 Flip animation plays when enemy plays their first clan upgrade card 


Bug fixes

 Turns could get stuck on an A.I that has 0 Rage (fixed)
 Friends from my Steam friend list appeared only after they had played an online game (fixed)
 Invading with Hildisvini from the "Played Cards" stopped the game flow (fixed)
 Cards in hand could overlap during God's Gift (fixed)
 Using a second card in combat blocked the game (fixed)
 If you moused over one of the cards in your hand when trying to play another card the two cards were unreadable (fixed)
 Cards in hand were overlapping when resuming a game (fixed)
 The STR couldn’t be seen for some monsters (fixed)
 The timer continued for the host when an AI was playing (fixed)
 Mystics figures took some time to disappear after their death (fixed)
 In Single Player mode, the Ragnarok effects appeared before the Ragnarok at the beginning of the game (fixed)
 Couldn’t join a friend’s game when creating a match (fixed)
 On some versions, there were no discard feedbacks (fixed)
 Invited friends could have their cards overlapping the Valhalla or the Statistics screen (fixed)
 Tutorial's chapter names didn't change when changing the language (fixed)
 Some cards were visible through the Valhalla tab (fixed)
 Frost Giant - Inconsistent capitalisation for character's nameplates (fixed)
 The feedback when displaying the units into Valhalla was shown only once (fixed)
 The card of Hildisvini could be played even if you had the total amount of figures (fixed)
 Battle statistics didn't list rage usage by Tyr's Prowess (fixed)
 Battleshield "Battle for" text was not localized (fixed)
 Ingame Option Setting used old fonts (fixed)
 Unable to access battle statistics for draw (fixed)
 Hotseat: missing sound on ok button for next player screen (fixed)
 Misplaced card content on battle statistics screen (fixed)
 Missing sound on language & resolution dropdowns (fixed)
 Texts overlapping in Valhalla screen (fixed)
 Misplaced player amount number on played cards (fixed)
 Invisible rage stat indicator (fixed)


Known bugs

 On some Mac setups, display issues can appear such as a faulty rendering of the sea or a stuttering in somes animations. We are trying to identify and fix the issue as soon as we can.


I will see you on the battlefield, and do not forget courage is better than keenest steel.
Onward, brothers and sisters!

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Update 1.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
Heil og sæl my illustrious mates!

Today is generous with us, as many improvements and bug fixes have been made.

Change Log

Visibility, UI and Gameplay improvements

Board and map


 Clearer borders
 New province outlines & highlights
 Clearer figures and new figure highlights
 Improved the province's overlay
 Clearer village outlines, overlay & highlights
 Better luminosity and saturation of the board
 Better saturation and hovering of the UI
 Less 3D noise for a better readability of the board


Battle flow


 Specific borderline for battle - when you start a battle/pillage in a province, the dotted line now becomes highlighted in red
 Updated the battle shield to show:
[olist]
 Who is the pillager
 What gets pillaged
 Who is winning and won the battle 
[/olist]  New ‘Battle’ icon displayed instead of the old ‘Pillage Resources’ (Axes, Rage or Horns) to increase visibility on which region is getting pillaged
 Added axe visuals on the battle shield to clarify the battle/pillage interaction
 Clearer title (“Battle for Province's name”)
 Add text on the battle shield to explain the ‘discard battle card’ phase


Miscellaneous


 In menus and lobbies, interactive elements are now properly displayed as buttons
 Bigger readable fonts
 The playmat is fully displayed at the start (setting available in options)
 Added a quit game confirmation pop up
 Proverb emotes are displayed for a longer time
 Showing if a game is ranked in the lobby
 New display line to better separate ongoing games in the multiplayer lobby


Various improvements and bug fixes


 Progressive optimization of the game’s performance
 It is now possible to decline Loki's Blessing
 Frigga’s Charm now does give a discount when replaced
 Dark Elf can now invade Yggdrasil when using Frigga's Domain
 Tyr's Judgement card doesn’t have a blurry image in the Compendium anymore
 Various spelling mistakes fixed


Jeg ønsker dere og deres familie god helse og velstand, til vi møtes i Valhall som einherjer!

I wish you and your families good health and prosperity, until we meet in the halls of Valhalla, my fellow Einherjer!

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Bug fix patch notes on 1.1
notes.notes:
Góðan daginn glorious warriors,

We have been working hard to continue on improving the game and address the issues that you valiantly and honorably keep on reporting to us!

We are very grateful for your unwavering loyalty and dedication to the game, and we will be able to put in a good word for your entry into Valhalla as you fight with us everyday to help improving the game.

As a token of our appreciation, let us present to you the many bug fixes that we are implementing with this patch.
In the name of all that is holy, we wish you good luck on this journey and shall see you on the other end... of this change log. 
Farewell, my illustrious mates!

Change Log


Green and orange circles around Ymir when selecting him or selecting another figurine from the same province are now visible
The image in the "Figure limit" prompt in the tutorial is now in the proper resolution
The "Keep none" prompt for one player when finishing a phase with one card is now visible
The user can no longer move their clan banner off-screen in the Player Profile
In the Player Profile, the Serpent Clan's text was overflowing its allocated space in the Most Played Clan's stats (fixed)
The word "cards" was not highlighted when selecting another section and going back to it (fixed)
The user was unable to use "w,a,s,d" after force quitting the game and then continuing the match (fixed)
Sometimes, the STR of battle cards did overlap the text during the Discard phase (fixed)
During draft phase, some battle cards may have display overlapping text (fixed)
The sixth card and above in the player's hand was overlapping when hovering over the first card in his hand (fixed)
The "Select all" was not highlighted when selected in the Mythical Monsters menu (fixed)
Cards of the opponent clan's information were displayed during the transition to the next player in local multiplayer (fixed)
The amount of glory rewarded by the card "Loki's Domain" was given to the wrong player (fixed)
Player could not move the God after a battle (fixed)
On MAC and slow devices, Gods' Gift was blocked in single player if a guest player was in the game (fixed)
When a player is replaced by an AI, notification for other players has been added (fixed)
Gamer tags of players who joined the user's last game in Multiplayer remained visible when hovering the first seat (fixed)
Selecting mythical monsters and switching tabs caused them to be displayed as not selected even though they were (fixed)
Two versions of the same mythical monster appeared as selected when selecting one and dragging out of the "Choose" window (fixed)
The images on the mythical monsters cards displayed in the compendium and in matches appeared blurry (fixed)
Game flow sometimes stopped during a battle in local multiplayer with more than two players (fixed)
Only the prompts "Confirm" and "Skip" were displayed when playing Thor's Domain (fixed)
The Thor's Domain card was not displayed when the choice to pillage for 2 rage was displayed (fixed)
Frigga's Succor card was not displayed when the ability was available, only a cancel button was shown (fixed)
When finishing a phase with one card, the card was not centered in the Discard Phase (fixed)
SFX when placing figurines on the board in the tutorial was missing (fixed)
Cards can be seen-through when dragged to the top of the screen based on the zoom's intensity (fixed)
Playing the card "Heimdal's Sight" in a combat resulting in a draw was causing a softlock (fixed)
Overlap was seen on the player's turn banner in French, Italian and German when displaying clan's name while playing against AIs (fixed)
Hovering the "Cancel Info" button in the Info menu was not highlighting the button (fixed)
When Ragnarok changes province due to Garm or Fenrir, the original target was keeping the warning Placing Hildisvini in one of the monster slots while the maximum number of unit was reached was still adding it to the total units in play (fixed)
The Gamelog displayed the starting player twice (fixed)
The Glory earned on the result screen was not updated with the Glory stats (fixed)
In the compendium, scrolling in a tab affected the other tabs, causing them to not start at the beginning (fixed)
In the tutorial IX, there was a delay for the discard menu when asked to choose one card to keep (fixed)
The Warning message was triggered even when the player couldn't play the card (fixed)
When withdrawing to Yggdrasil with the Volur Witch, the card was not displayed and it showed that it would cost 1 rage (fixed)


We acknowledge your perseverance and support if you made it all the way here, both for the patchnote and the game, and care to precise we will keep up the hard work until the game reaches your hopes and satisfies you, our beloved and worthy community.

May the Gods bless and watch over you and your loved ones!

notes.title: Blood Rage: Digital Edition - Update 1.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
Heil og sæl fellow Vikings, may you be healthy and happy as this ancestral saying wishes upon you!

We come to you bearing gifts, as we have worked on several improvements since the last update. 
You can find below a list of the improvements that are being implemented this patch, making the battles in the nine realms more glorious to ensure your entry into Valhalla!

Change Log

Visibility and UI:


 Figures and slots on the island are bigger for improved visibility on the map


 Confirmation overlays are displayed when starting a battle and playing a battle card


 Language selection is now possible in-game through the ‘Settings’ in the ‘Main Menu’


 A glory gain animation has been added at the end of the match to visualize the end game glory gain


 Started matches of other players are visible in the lobby


Gameplay:


 Last remaining human player is the winner of a match, regardless if he played to the end or left the game earlier


 In multiplayer matches, players do not have to wait for other players to confirm the battle outcome to continue and/or start their turn


With the addition of some bug fixes, this is it for the current update, but please provide us with your feedback and suggestions for improvements for Blood Rage: Digital Edition in the comments below. 
Your feedback is of the utmost importance to us and please rest assured we are continuously working to improve the game and address the issues you, as a community, report to us.

Till next time, hold on to your helms and fight with honor to impress the Gods!
